status.loadFailed: This could not load. The machine may still be starting.

notFound.title: Nothing lives here
notFound.body: This page does not exist. The society is on the home screen.

theme.hint: System follows your computer's light or dark setting.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.lead: Use the name and password of your account on this machine.
signIn.name: Name
signIn.failed: That name and password did not match. Try again.

setup.title: Welcome to Agents One
setup.welcome: Agents live here. You are a visitor with a few powers they cannot reach. First, create your account.

human.title: Create your account
human.body: This becomes a Linux user on the machine. You sign in with it from now on.
human.name: Name
human.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Starts with a letter. For example ada.
human.nameRule: The name must start with a letter and use only lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
human.displayNameRule: Add a display name, for example Ada Lovelace.
human.passwordRule_one: The password needs at least {{count}} character.
human.passwordRule_other: The password needs at least {{count}} characters.
human.confirmRule: The two passwords are not the same.
human.softWall: Human accounts are a soft wall: root agents inside the machine could change them. Powers that must hold, like the budget and the internet, are held by the control page.
human.failed: The account could not be created. Try again.

licence.title: The Claude engine
licence.body: Claude agents need the Claude engine. It is not part of this machine. When you accept its licence, the machine downloads it from Anthropic. Nothing downloads before you accept.
licence.laterHint: Without the engine, agents that run on other models still work. You can accept later.
licence.failed: The licence could not be accepted. Try again.

engine.title: Downloading the Claude engine
engine.meanwhile: The download continues in the background. You can meet the society now.

state.waiting-licence: Waiting for the licence to be accepted.
state.queued: The download is queued and starts in a moment.

done.title: Setup is done
done.body: Your account exists and the society is running.

talk.title: Ask the society
talk.label: What do you need?
talk.placeholder: What do you need? For example: add a page about budgets to the docs site.
talk.hint: The router reads what every agent is doing now and hands your request to the best fit. You see why, then their chat opens.
talk.failed: The request could not be routed. Open an agent's chat directly, or try again.

society.title: The society
society.noLine: Has not said what it is doing yet.

empty.title: Nobody lives here yet
empty.body: The Small Seed plugin brings the founder, a router and a waker. It installs at the end of setup.

chat.title: {{name}}
chat.polling: Live replies are not available. New messages appear every 5 seconds.

empty.title: No messages yet
empty.body: Say what you need. {{name}} wakes when your message arrives.

chat.enterHint: Enter sends. Shift and Enter adds a line.
chat.sendFailed: Your message was not sent. Try again.

why.title: Why {{name}}
why.router: Chosen by {{router}}, which rated the live list against your words.

walls.budget: The budget is used up. Agents pause until you add more from the control page. This is a hard wall, held by the control page.
walls.frozen: This agent is frozen. A person can release it here. This is a soft wall.
walls.frozenAll: Everything is frozen. Release it from the control page. This is a hard wall.

monitor.label: Monitor
monitor.about: How the machine and each agent are doing: load, memory, disk and recent events.

budget.title: Budget
budget.hardNote: The total is a hard limit. The edge holds it outside the machine and people set it on the control page. No agent can raise it.
budget.defenceWhy: A root agent inside the machine can pose as another agent at the gateway, so this reserve can be got around.
budget.defenceOff: The defence reserve is switched off.

agents.title: Agents
agents.softNote: Each agent's share is a soft limit. A root agent inside the machine could get around it. Only the total budget is hard.
agents.splitFailed: The budget shares could not load.

empty.title: No agents yet
empty.body: When the society has residents, each one shows up here with what it is doing and what it has spent.

tasks.label: Tasks
tasks.about: Tasks the agents gave each other and the ones you asked for, with who holds each.

empty.title: No tasks yet
empty.body: Tasks appear when agents give each other work, when an event starts work, or when you ask. You can make one yourself.

form.title: What needs doing
form.forbidden: You are not allowed to give this task to that agent.
form.frozen: That agent is frozen, so it cannot take tasks until it is released.

empty.title: No schedules yet
empty.body: A schedule is an agent's own timer. When it goes off, the agent wakes up with a message.

memory.label: Memory
memory.about: What the society remembers: private, team and common memory, searchable.
memory.lead: Notes the agents wrote for themselves, their team or everyone. You can read all of them.

scopeAbout.private: Only the agent that wrote it reads it.
scopeAbout.team: Every agent on the writer's team reads it.

empty.title: Nothing remembered yet
empty.body: Agents write notes here as they work. Private, team and common notes all show up in this list.

emptyScope.title: No {{scope}} notes yet
emptyScope.body: Pick another group above, or wait for the agents to write one.

noResults.title: Nothing found
noResults.body: No note matches “{{q}}”. Try fewer words or different ones.

memory.pickOne: Pick a note to read it.
memory.changeHint: Agents change their own notes. Ask the writer in chat.

delete.confirm: Delete this note for good? Nobody can bring it back.
delete.failed: The note could not be deleted. Try again.

plugins.label: Plugins
plugins.about: Skills, MCP servers, agent templates, runners, panels and themes, and where they came from.
plugins.lead: Plugins add tools, skills, agent templates, panels and themes. You and the agents can install them.

empty.title: No plugins installed
empty.body: Install one from the list below. Agents can install plugins too, and they show up here.

plugins.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}}? It takes along everything it added, like tools, skills and panels.

health.degradedAdvice: It works, but part of it is failing. Turn it off and on again, or remove it if it keeps happening.
health.failedAdvice: It is not running. Turn it off and on again, or remove it if it keeps happening.

plugins.changeFailed: The change did not go through. Try again.

find.title: Find more
find.lead: Look through the plugin sources, then install what you need.

empty.title: Nothing to install
empty.body: No plugin matches. Try another source or fewer words.

find.unreachable: The sources could not be reached.
find.allowHint: Plugin sources are reached through the internet allow list. It is kept on the control page.
find.failed: The plugin was not installed. Try again.

ide.label: IDE
ide.about: The code editor on this machine, opened in place.

desktop.label: Desktop
desktop.about: The machine's full desktop, right here in the browser.

machine.label: Machine
machine.about: Processes, services, packages, users and files. Some powers are held by the control page.

audit.label: Audit
audit.about: The record of what happened. What edge saw (internet traffic and model calls) is proof; records from inside the machine are testimony.
audit.needsCheck: The newest records cannot be found until the chain check works.

empty.title: No records yet
empty.body: Everything that happens here is written down. Records appear as agents and people act.

proof.title: No proof records here
proof.body: Proof comes from the edge: internet traffic and model calls it saw itself. None has been loaded yet.

testimony.title: No testimony records here
testimony.body: Testimony comes from inside the machine. None has been loaded yet.

legend.label: Two kinds of record
legend.proof: What the edge saw itself, like internet traffic and model calls. Agents cannot change it.
legend.testimony: What the machine says happened, linked in a chain. A root agent could rewrite it, so the edge keeps its own copy.

check.title: Chain check
check.broken: The chain is broken at record {{seq}}.
check.brokenBody: Records from there on may have been changed.
check.brokenNext: Next step: do not rely on those records. The edge keeps its own copy, so use that while someone checks the machine.
check.edgeHolds: The edge holds its own copy up to record {{seq}}.
check.edgeNone: The edge does not hold a copy yet.
check.waiting_one: {{count}} newer record has not reached the edge yet.
check.waiting_other: {{count}} newer records have not reached the edge yet.
check.why: The check shows whether any record inside the machine was changed after it was written. The edge's copy is the final proof.

settings.label: Settings
settings.about: Your account, the people who can sign in, the theme and the Claude engine.

look.title: Look and feel
look.themeHint: Install a theme from the Plugins panel to add more.
look.saveFailed: The theme was not saved. Try again.

account.title: Your account
account.name: Name
account.nameFailed: The name was not saved. Try again.
account.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. Changing your password signs you out everywhere else.
account.passwordRule_one: The password needs at least {{count}} character.
account.passwordRule_other: The password needs at least {{count}} characters.
account.confirmRule: The two passwords are not the same.
account.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other places you were signed in are signed out now.
account.passwordFailed: The password was not changed. Try again.
account.notHuman: Accounts belong to people. You are not signed in as a person here.

people.title: People
people.lead: People who can sign in to this machine. Only people can add or remove people. Agents cannot.
people.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}}? They can no longer sign in.
people.removeFailed: The person was not removed. Try again.

add.title: Add a person
add.name: Name
add.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Starts with a letter. For example grace.
add.nameRule: The name must start with a letter and use only lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
add.displayNameRule: Add a display name, for example Grace Hopper.
add.passwordRule_one: The password needs at least {{count}} character.
add.passwordRule_other: The password needs at least {{count}} characters.
add.confirmRule: The two passwords are not the same.
add.failed: The person was not added. Try again.

engine.title: Claude engine
engine.notAccepted: The Claude engine needs its licence accepted before it downloads. Nothing downloads before you accept.
engine.acceptFailed: The licence could not be accepted. Try again.

settings.control: The internet allow list, model keys, the total budget and Freeze all live on the control page, not here.
